name: c_section
prompt: Make a new fan-made Manchester United poster collage in EXACTLY the same visual style as the four reference images: overlapping torn-paper cutouts and vintage magazine and newspaper clippings, halftone dot texture, grainy print, bold palette of Manchester United red (#DA291C), black, white and yellow (#FBE122), football players in red kits celebrating (generic faces, not real identifiable people), the red devil club crest, lifted trophies, Old Trafford stadium cutouts, red scarves and flags, and big block typography headlines such as 'GLORY GLORY MAN UNITED', 'THE TREBLE', 'MANCHESTER IS RED', '#IAMUNITED', 'OLD TRAFFORD'. Players must have natural, complete faces (illustrated or photographic), never blank or blurred faces.
